content:
Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by holiday deal pricing now live again on AirPods Pro 3 via Amazon alongside all AirPods Max 2 colors back at Amazon lows and nearly 25% off AirPods 4. We also have Apple’s most affordable current-gen M5 MacBook Pro sitting at $1,499 Amazon all-time low ($300 off launch price) and these 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models at up to $270 off. Head below for a closer look.

Heads up: Holiday deal now live on AirPods Pro 3 again down at $199 via Amazon

This morning Amazon is giving folks another shot at holiday pricing on Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3. Now back at 20% off the list price, this is on par with one of the lowest prices we have tracked to date.

Amazon is now offering AirPods Pro 3 down at $199.99 shipped. Regularly $249, this is 20% off the list price.

Today’s deal comes within just $1 of the Memorial Day pricing and the lowest price we have tracked this month.

It is, in fact, within $1 of the best deal we have ever tracked at Amazon outside of a very short lived offer down at $185. Amazon delivered this deal following a price drop at the Verizon store that was reportedly a bit of a run around for many folks. Some did secure a set at that price, but you, by and large, had to buy them online and then pop over to a brick and mortar Verizon shop to pick them up (if the one near you was offering that deal, anyway). Amazon did price match here, but it went in and out of stock several times randomly over the course of a day or so when this deal was live.

While we have been waiting on another notable deal for AirPods 4 with ANC since mid-March, this AirPods Pro 3 discount is joining price drops on the base model AirPods 4 and AirPods Max 2 this weekend:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199.99 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $509 (Reg. $549)

Land a new set of Apple’s most affordable AirPods 4 for the summer at nearly 25% off

All AirPods Max 2 colors return to Amazon low pricing this week

Apple’s most affordable current-gen M5 MacBook Pro sitting at $1,499 Amazon all-time low ($300 off launch price)

We caught some deep price drops across the 2026 MacBook lineup last week and over the weekend. But just as pricing is starting to jump back up by $50 or more on most of them, we wanted to highlight this $200 price drop on the most affordable current-gen M5 MacBook Pro you can buy (that’s $300 off its late 2025 release date).

Amazon is offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB internal storage capacity down at $1,499 shipped. This deal is only still live on the Space Black and it might not be for much longer.

Regularly $1,699, this is $200 off the list price and matching the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon. This is really only the second time it has been down this low since release.

As a quick refresher, this model released in late 2025 as the first MacBook to house Apple’s latest M5 chip. It started life at $1,799 and is now $300 less than that – Apple has since ditched the 512GB storage tier on the current-generation MacBook lineup, which has effectively lowered the MSRP on this machine to $1,699.

Deal pricing going up on M5 MacBook Air this week, but these 15-inch models are still up to $270 off

We caught a number of notable M5 MacBook Air deals last week and this past weekend. However, most models are stating to jump back up in price at this point and we wanted to shine some light on the base model 15-incher – this one is still at the Amazon all-time low at $200 off the list price and we have some upgraded models below at up to $270 off.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 M5 MacBook Air with the 15-inch Liquid Retina Display, 16GB of RAM, and a 512GB SSD down at $1,099 shipped.

Regularly $1,299, this is $200 off, matching the Amazon all-time low, and one of a few models on the short list of configs still sitting at the lowest prices we have tracked on Amazon.

There are a few upgraded 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models with deeper deals than this at B&H right now (you’ll find those below), but Amazon has largely remained the only major retailer delivering the lowest prices to date on the most affordable models in the lineup. As you can see below, B&H has a few seriously notable deals on select M5 MacBook Air configs with upgraded storage and RAM specs right now at up $270 off:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/512GB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,719)
  • With 70W USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)

Giant price drops hit official Apple Solo Loops today: One from $15, multi-packs from $9 each (Orig. up to $99 each)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Score Samsung’s 32-inch M8 Smart Monitor with webcam for your Mac workstation while it’s 50% off today
  • Anker 140W 4-port Laptop Charger with smart display is down to $60 low today
  • Anker’s latest 45W Smart Display Nano Charger drops to $28 Amazon low (All colors, 30% off)
  • New Beats 240W 10-foot braided USB-C cable now nearly 30% off at Amazon
  • Score a spare 140W MagSafe 3 cable for your MacBook while this braided USB-C cord is under $20

Amazon delivering all base MacBook Neo models as early as tomorrow from $590, still up to 2 weeks from Apple

Apple’s new MacBook Neo made headlines everywhere, delivering the most affordable new MacBook solution in years and Apple has has a hard time keeping up with demand to some degree. There is still a 1 to 2 week wait time for deliveries on the base model straight from Apple, but Amazon is now shipping all colors at $10 less and delivering them as early as tomorrow.

If you’re looking to land a new MacBook Neo this week, or even next at this point, perhaps something for Dad, Amazon not only has the best price, but it is guaranteeing delivery much faster than Apple is on most configurations right now:

  • MacBook Neo Citrus 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Citrus 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by Saturday
  • MacBook Neo Indigo 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Indigo 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Blush 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Blush 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

Apple’s iPhone Air MagSafe Battery is sitting at its best price ever right now (40% off)

Apple’s current-gen base iPad is down at $299 shipped on Amazon today

Arguably the best iPad you can buy for young kids, if not just because it won’t cost a fortune, the iPad 11 can also just be a great low-cost option for anyone when it comes to casual use, road trips, or just as a couch browser around the house. It is also one you can land down at $299 on Amazon right now in most colors.

Amazon has Apple’s current-generation 11-inch iPad (A16) sitting down at $299 shipped right now in Blue, Pink, and Silver – the Yellow model is a touch higher at $319, but we recommend waiting until it is at most $299 before pulling the trigger.

We have caught this deal a few times this year at least, but have yet to see it drop any lower than this since the holiday season last year when it feel an additional $25 or so on select colors.

While the A16-powered machine might seem underwhelming for those with cash to spend on an iPad Air or better, and there is no Apple Intelligence action on this model, it can, again, make for a great low-cost option for casual users. The iPad mini might, perhaps, be better for young kids as it can be a little bit easier to get their hands around it, but at 11-inches, this thing isn’t huge and gives them a whole lot more screen real estate when it comes to educational content, games, and watching shows.

If it is the iPad Air you’re after, scope out the clearance deals on the previous-gen M3 at up to $350 off– this can be a notable option for the slightly older kids and those who just don’t need the latest chip – as well as the newer M4 price drops you’ll find waiting down below:

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $839 (Reg. $899)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,019 (Reg. $1,099)
